lower_bound_adjustment.reason: Fold reference localizer objective constant into this stored row at verify time.

source.description: Final restored SOC row for reference localizer perturbation, stored directly.

interval_rounding_note: Support-charge enclosure uses mpmath interval arithmetic at dps>=70. This is independently re-verifiable but is not an Arb-level directed-rounding certificate.

expected_psd_certificate.assumption: Gram entries are the exact binary64 coefficients produced by the reconstructed certificate; residual bound is outward padded analytically under IEEE-754 round-to-nearest arithmetic.
expected_psd_certificate.method: shifted Cholesky residual correction with Higham gamma_n binary64 roundoff envelope

localizer_gram_block.stored_binary64_convention: Intervals are degenerate decimal encodings of the binary64 values used in reference. The verifier treats their float64 midpoints as the exact stored coefficients for the residual-corrected Cholesky audit.

purpose: Package the reference improved hardened global lower bound so a standalone verifier can recompute the bound and Gram PSD from stored coefficients alone, without re-solving or transfer reconstruction.
schema: public standalone improved SOC/localizer audit certificate package v1
